scope: Estimate gas inventory and vacuum maintenance on fixed 021b P2 and 022c equilateral 019-reserve P3 geometries. No structural reoptimization or certified sealed life.

environment.water_basis: 019 optimistic 1 kPa humidity is an owner scenario. Film rate transfer from source temperature to 500 m is PROJECTION; no activation energy is known.

mixture_note: Dry fractions are a declared nominal mixture, normalized to unity; CO2 is a 400 ppm scenario, not a current atmospheric measurement. Other trace gases remain unmeasured NFI.

P2.source: 021b floating_point plus 028 scarf method, re-sized to 021b
P2.permeation_note: Be faces and metal foil set to zero bulk ambient-gas permeation in the screen, not a measured upper bound. Only the outer scarf polymer path is charged with the core vented to the interior; no full-area adhesive flux is added through intact metal. AF and scarf coefficient unsourced.

P3.geometry_note: Use cap sag from original 022c filing, not a new pillow validation. Surface area multiplier is a separate sensitivity; true pillow area and frame excluded volume remain unqualified.
P3.material_mapping: Both rows retain SiC tubes: 3100 kg/m3, 410 GPa. The ti and cfrp prefixes name the 023 end fittings, not tube materials. Verified from 022 INPUTS and 023 corrected filing; mass/(tube area*length) independently confirms 3100.
P3.SiC_surface_release_note: 0.1 g/m2 finite water-equivalent surface inventory across inner and outer tube surfaces; PROJECTION, no matched SiC desorption result.

joint_adhesive.name: EA 9394
joint_adhesive.source: NASA GSFC35448 HYSOL EA9394, TML 2.63%; historical unmatched cure/lot. Joint bond area = 2*members*N/tau; 023 end-material bill excludes this adhesive.
joint_adhesive.note: Gap and density are PROJECTION. The lap-shear transfer is inherited, not qualified. Adhesive is exposed to hull vacuum but is not an exterior gas-barrier layer.

kapton.argon_note: Ar coefficient set equal to N2 as PROJECTION; no measured value in opened source.
kapton.water_source_condition: Table 10, water ASTM E96; gas test 23 C and 50% RH; separate water driving RH not specified. Mapping that water rate to 1 kPa service driving pressure is PROJECTION.
kapton.outgas_source: NASA GSFC10365 KAPTON FILM, TML 0.97%, CVCM 0, WVR 0.80%; not an HN/gauge-matched lot.

zylon.moisture_condition: Toyobo HM equilibrium moisture at 20 C and 65% RH; finite water inventory proxy, not a measured desorption rate.
zylon.cfrp_proxy_source: NASA GSFC12224 CYCOM 985-T300 graphite/epoxy TML 0.57%, unmatched to 023 wrap resin. Applied only to 022c m_joint (CFRP end wraps), not to the SiC tubes; PROJECTION.
zylon.barrier: 12 um OD3 aluminized Mylar, source coupon
zylon.PET_TML_source: NASA GSFC32902 aluminized Mylar, different grade/gauge; TML .26%, WVR .18%.

mylar.water_source_condition: 12 um OD3, <1 g/m2/day at 38 C/90% RH. O2 test 25 C/45% RH, pure oxygen; one-atmosphere differential assumed.
mylar.note: N2/Ar/CO2/He/H2 rates are assumed, not measured. A porous Zylon crossply supplies no independent air barrier.

release_model.law: B*(1-exp(-t/tau)); finite outgassing inventories, not permanent daily TML. All release assigned to water for a high-pressure molecular-weight screen; composition/kinetics unmeasured.
release_model.conditioned_note: 90% removal is a required demonstrated conditioning target, not an established bake recipe.
release_model.scarf_and_seals_proxy: Unknown actual outgassing; 1 wt% inventory sensitivity, not NASA qualification.

leak_model.note: Whole-hull leak acceptance scenarios, not measured seam specifications. P2 counts outer skin seams once, core vented; P3 assumes individually seamed bays with excess node leakage counted separately. Humid external-gas composition. Structural frame joints are not automatically pressure penetrations; continuous membranes could avoid these seams.

KNF_N920_APDCB.source: KNF N920 datasheet pp1,3,4; curve approximate, not nominal 21 STP L/min used as inlet speed.

Edwards_E2M28.input_note: Electrical planning assumption. Manual states mechanical 750 W and 230 V/4.5 A, not 750 W measured electrical consumption.
Edwards_E2M28.source: Edwards A37310880_X pp14-18; web text verified, direct download returned 403.

systems.base_hardware_note: Same 019 owner estimates, no qualified bill. Ground pumping plant excluded only from flying mass. Existing 100 kg is retained; no allowance double-count.

getters.water_sieve_source: BASF 4A water capacity 21 wt% at 25 C/80% RH; derated usable scenario .10 kg water/kg dry bed for hull vacuum. Capacity/rate at service pressure not qualified.
getters.NEXTorr_note: St172 room-temperature single-gas UHV capacities to 10% initial speed, after activation. Species capacities are not additive. UHV result not a rough-vacuum product recommendation; noble gases use powered ion section.
getters.COMBO_note: SAES documents RT N2/O2/H2O/H2/CO/CO2 uptake with no activation, but no public capacity/rate in opened page: no mass credit.

prior_024_check.note: Reproduce prior gas conversion at its old gauge; new 022c Kapton thickness is about 550 um.

boundary_of_claim: Seam leakage, moisture transfer, desorption time constants, actual resins, barrier fabrication and conditioning are not measured. Numeric lives are conditional scenarios. NFI is the missing evidence, not a reason to halt this calculation.
